en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Romanesque cathedral and adjacent civic buildings on a square. The image shows the cathedral with its octagonal central tower, rounded apse, side chapels, and arcaded details. Beside it are fortified-looking buildings with battlements and a tall clock tower. In the foreground are a vendor's stand, fencing, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption in red at the top left reads "TRENTO — Duomo".
